top_stories.title: Microsoft Authenticator Flaw Let Permissionless Android Apps Steal Work Account Tokens
top_stories.summary: Microsoft has patched CVE-2026-80097, a vulnerability in Microsoft Authenticator for Android that allowed a permissionless malicious app to impersonate trusted Microsoft applications and steal work account authentication tokens. The fix is included in Authenticator for Android version 6.2606.4246, and all users are advised to update immediately.

top_stories.title: Microsoft 365 Token-Replay Attacks Compromise 97 Accounts at 79 Organizations
top_stories.summary: Cybersecurity researchers at Huntress documented a Microsoft 365 campaign using adversary-in-the-middle (AitM) relay attacks to steal and replay authentication tokens, compromising 97 accounts across 79 organizations. The attacks, observed between July 14 and September 22, 2026, involved capturing active sign-in sessions to bypass authentication controls and gain unauthorized access to email accounts.

top_stories.title: Cisco Rethinks Privileged Infrastructure Access
top_stories.summary: Cisco has launched Privileged Infrastructure Access, a solution that replaces standing administrative access with identity-bound, cryptographic controls. The product targets privileged access management for critical infrastructure, competing in the PAM space with session-based, just-in-time access controls.

top_stories.title: Passkey enrollment and account recovery, the new weak point
top_stories.summary: This article addresses passkey enrollment and account recovery vulnerabilities in Microsoft Entra ID, specifically covering Registration campaigns, Temporary Access Pass, and protecting security-info registration. It is part four of a seven-part series on migrating from MFA to passkeys in Microsoft Entra ID, focusing on preventing help-desk recovery processes from becoming authentication bypasses.

top_stories.title: The 2% Problem: Three Vendors Built Agent-Identity Governance. Almost Nobody Is Using It.
top_stories.summary: SailPoint has highlighted a critical gap in enterprise AI security, revealing that while 79% of enterprises run AI agents in production, only 2% have deployed agent-identity governance controls. SailPoint is among three vendors that have built agent-identity governance capabilities, addressing how automated AI workers should be managed within IAM frameworks.

news.title: NIST starts the countdown to retire quantum-vulnerable encryption
news.summary: NIST released NIST IR 8547, a roadmap for transitioning federal systems to post-quantum cryptography (PQC), building on standards published in August 2024. The report specifies which cryptographic methods must be replaced, transition timelines, and considerations for organizations, with earlier deadlines applying to certain sensitive federal systems.

news.title: ShinyHunters-Exploited Oracle PeopleSoft Zero-Day Turns Out to Be Three Chained Flaws
news.summary: A critical Oracle PeopleSoft vulnerability exploited by ShinyHunters since May consists of three chained flaws—an SSRF, an internal management interface exposure, and a third component—patched by Oracle under CVE-2026-35273 in June. PeopleSoft is widely used for HR and identity management functions, making this vulnerability relevant to IAM professionals managing enterprise access through the platform.

news.title: Microsoft releases Windows OOB updates to distrust eMudhra certificates
news.summary: Microsoft released out-of-band Windows updates to revoke trust in certificates associated with compromised eMudhra certificate authority keys. The updates target systems that do not receive automatic certificate trust list updates, addressing a PKI trust chain compromise affecting a major Indian certificate authority.

news.title: Hackers bury inboxes in spam then show up on Microsoft Teams posing as IT support
news.summary: Threat actors are conducting social engineering attacks by flooding employee inboxes with spam, then contacting victims via Microsoft Teams external chat while impersonating IT help desk personnel. Arctic Wolf documented over 400 such incidents, where fake help desk messages arrived shortly after inbox flooding to establish false urgency and trust.

news.title: Socure links AI agents to verified people and businesses
news.summary: Socure has launched Agent Intelligence, a platform suite that detects AI agents, assigns trust scores, and ties each agent to a verified human or business identity that authorized it. The offering includes three components—Agent Detection (generally available), Agent TrustScore (beta), and Agent Credential (GA planned for Q1 2027)—addressing the emerging need to govern non-human identities in agentic AI workflows.

news.title: GoAhead TLS Flaws Allow Revoked Client Certificates and Enable Session Decryption
news.summary: A security flaw in the GoAhead embedded web server's TLS implementation failed to enforce certificate revocation checking, allowing revoked client certificates to successfully authenticate in mutual-TLS configurations using the OpenSSL backend. The vulnerability affects setups where a certificate revocation list (CRL) is configured but revocation checking was never actually enabled, meaning revoked credentials could still pass authentication.

news.title: AI-Generated Fake Login Pages Are Making Account Takeovers Easier
news.summary: Generative AI is enabling attackers to create more convincing fake login pages that can steal credentials, capture MFA codes, and hijack authenticated sessions. The threat targets both password-based authentication and MFA mechanisms, representing an escalating challenge for identity and access management defenses.

news.title: Keeper Security、2026年版Gartner(R) 「特権アクセス管理のマジック・クアドラント(TM)」に2年連続で選出
news.summary: Keeper Security has been named in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management for the second consecutive year. This recognition places Keeper Security among evaluated PAM vendors in Gartner's annual industry analyst report.

news.title: AI agent security with policy-driven access control
news.summary: A new piece addresses security challenges in agentic AI deployments, focusing on policy-driven access control as a governance mechanism. The article references Cloud Security Alliance research showing 70% of organizations have AI components in production while 82% lack real-time visibility into AI runtime behavior, highlighting access control gaps relevant to IAM practitioners managing AI agent permissions.

news.title: Attackers Use Microsoft Teams IT Support Scams to Deploy Malware and Ransomware
news.summary: Threat actors are exploiting Microsoft Teams' external chat feature to conduct IT support impersonation scams and deliver malware or ransomware. The attack pattern involves throwaway tenants and social engineering techniques across hundreds of documented incidents.

news.title: uCreator Android Spyware Can Steal Telegram 2FA Passwords and Clone WeChat Accounts
news.summary: A rentable Android spyware kit called uCreator has been discovered that steals Telegram 2FA passwords and clones WeChat accounts by hiding malicious code inside trojanized copies of the apps distributed outside official app stores. The kit's Telegram component has been linked to the Baohuo backdoor previously documented by security researchers.

news.title: Gheist Uses Stolen GitHub Tokens to Steal Private Repository Secrets via Actions Logs
news.summary: An automated campaign dubbed Gheist is using stolen GitHub tokens to inject malicious workflows that expose repository secrets through GitHub Actions logs, affecting private repositories and GitHub Enterprise environments. The attack vector relies on compromised authentication tokens, with Wiz researchers documenting how attackers download the exposed secrets before deleting evidence of the runs.

news.title: Akeyless Recognized in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Privileged Access Management
news.summary: Akeyless has been recognized in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management. The inclusion coincides with the company extending its Runtime Identity Security platform to cover human privileged access, in addition to AI agents and machine identities.

news.title: Xage Security Named in 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Privileged Access Management
news.summary: Xage Security has been named in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management, recognized for its Ability to Execute and Completeness of Vision. Xage focuses on identity-based Zero Trust solutions for high-stakes environments such as critical infrastructure.

news.title: Who Authorized That Agent? Enforcing AI Authority Before the Action
news.summary: The article addresses the emerging challenge of authorizing AI agents within enterprise environments, arguing that security teams must enforce authorization policies at runtime rather than at design time. The piece focuses on how traditional IAM and access control frameworks must adapt to govern non-human identities and autonomous agent actions.

news.title: Show HN: Frontdoor: find who can assume into your cloud accounts
news.summary: A new open-source tool called Frontdoor has been released to map federated identity trust relationships into cloud accounts across AWS, GCP, and Azure. It identifies external access paths including OIDC, SAML, cross-account, and cross-cloud role assumption chains, distributed as a single binary with no database requirement.

news.title: jumpserver v4.10.20
news.summary: JumpServer released version 4.10.20 of its open-source Privileged Access Management platform. The platform provides secure access to SSH, RDP, Kubernetes, Database, and RemoteApp endpoints through a web browser for DevOps and IT teams.

news.title: Three insights you may have missed from theCUBE’s coverage of Okta’s Oktane event
news.summary: theCUBE's coverage of Okta's Oktane event highlighted three key insights around AI agent governance and identity security. The coverage focused on how enterprises need identity controls that follow AI agent actions across applications beyond initial authentication, representing a shift in how identity security operates within workflows.

news.title: Trust Is Not What It Seems — and Fraudsters Are Counting on It
news.summary: Threat actors are bypassing technical security controls by using AI-assisted social engineering attacks against help desks to gain unauthorized access. The attack vector targets identity verification processes at service desks, a critical weak point in access management and authentication workflows.

news.title: AI Agents as Insider Threats: Inside Microsoft's Bet on a Unified Security Stack
news.summary: Microsoft's Project Perception introduces Guardian Agents designed to monitor and contain anomalous AI agent behavior as part of a unified security stack. The initiative addresses emerging concerns around AI agents acting as insider threats, a topic directly relevant to identity governance and zero trust access controls for non-human identities.

news.title: Enable cross-Region fine-grained data access with AWS Lake Formation and Trusted Identity Propagation
news.summary: AWS has expanded Trusted Identity Propagation with IAM Identity Center to support cross-Region fine-grained data access in Lake Formation. The feature allows corporate user identities to be propagated across AWS Regions when querying S3 and Redshift data governed by Lake Formation access controls.

news.title: Microsoft Plugs Nearly 1,000 Security Holes
news.summary: Microsoft released a record-breaking patch update addressing at least 974 security vulnerabilities across Windows operating systems and other software. Microsoft attributed the accelerated vulnerability discovery pace to AI assistance, while security experts noted organizations are struggling to keep up with testing and deploying the volume of monthly fixes.
